questions.prompt: 8 . Which of the following will stimulate the production of an antibody?
9.  After using the toilet you should wash your hands with soap and water in order to
options: kill all the bacteria on your hands.
questions.explanation: C:remove microorganisms from skin;soap does not necessarily kill every bacterium.

questions.prompt: 10. The essential difference between a bacterium and a virus is that a virus
options: can only be spread by personal contact.
reproduces only in a living organism.
questions.explanation: C:viruses require living host cells to replicate.
